pictures.scene: El Greco, The Agony in the Garden — one man kneeling alone on a bare hillside at night with His face lifted and turned up into the dark, the whole picture filled by His figure in a great rose pink robe falling in long heavy folds over a deep crimson tunic, both arms opened wide and low with the palms turned up and empty, a dark blue mantle slipped off and spread out on the ground behind and beneath Him in cold folds, a huge tawny brown rock rising behind Him over the whole upper half with a few dry golden tufts growing from its face, strange pale grey white clouds rolling in at both upper corners of the sky, a faint ray of light coming down from the left across the rock, the bearded face worked out in warm light with the eyes raised and the lips parted as He speaks, a thin dry bush at the right beside His hand, and the dark brown earth of the slope running out at the bottom, he lifted up his eyes to heaven and said, father, the hour has come, glorify your son, that your son may glorify you, …
pictures.name: pd_el_greco_agony_in_the_garden

pictures.scene: Jan van Eyck, God the Father, from the Ghent Altarpiece — one enormous seated figure shown from the waist and filling the whole panel, the grave frontal face worked out in fine warm light with wide calm eyes looking straight out at us, a long dark brown beard and dark hair falling in curls on both shoulders, a towering white and gold three crowned tiara set with pearls, sapphires and rubies on His head, a burnished gold ground behind Him scored all over with fine ruled rays running outward like the spokes of a great wheel, a wide gold arch above cut with dark Latin letters round and round it, a deep crimson robe over His shoulders falling in heavy folds, a long jewelled band sewn with crosses and pearls hanging down both sides of His breast, a great round golden clasp of pearls and blue stones fastened at the middle, gold brocaded ornament at either side behind His shoulders, and His right hand raised at the left edge of the picture in blessing, now this is eternal life, that they may know you, the only true god, and jesus christ, whom you have sent, …
pictures.name: pd_van_eyck_god_the_father

pictures.scene: Ivan Aivazovsky, Chaos, The Creation of the World — a world of nothing but cloud, light and water, the whole upper half a vast worked sky of warm gold and grey with a white blaze of light burning in the middle of it high up, small pale winged shapes carried in the heart of that blaze, a huge dark mass of storm cloud hanging directly beneath the light and spreading its arms out to both sides of the picture, further banks of grey and brown vapour rolling down the left side and along the right, long shafts of gold breaking through the gaps between them, below the cloud a wild open sea with no land and no ship on it anywhere, the waves running up in ridges of white crest after crest, dark hollows between them, and in the very middle a broad track of light falling straight out of the blaze and lying on the black water all the way to the bottom of the picture, glorify me in your presence with the glory i had with you before the world existed, …
pictures.name: pd_aivazovsky_chaos_the_creation_of_the_world

pictures.scene: Valentin de Boulogne, Saint Paul Writing His Epistles — one man bent low over a writing table out of a deep brown dark, the high balding forehead furrowed in three deep lines and lit from above, the eyes cast down at his work, a long reddish brown beard falling forward onto his breast, a dark green robe with the sleeve pushed back from the wrist and a heavy vermilion cloak falling from his far shoulder and spreading right across the bottom of the picture in great folds, his right hand lowered at the left of the table with the quill just dipped into a small black inkwell, a broad board table running across the lower third of the picture in warm bare wood, on it a thick open book with the pages catching the full light and a loose white sheet laid across them, a second book lying open at the left with a round reading glass set on its leaves, a penknife and a little pile of cut paper at the right, and the whole upper left of the picture simply dark, for i have given them the words you gave me, and they have received them, …
pictures.name: pd_valentin_paul

pictures.scene: Emanuel de Witte, Interior of the Oude Kerk, Amsterdam — the inside of a great whitewashed gothic church worked out in fine pale grey and cream from the flagstones to the vault, tall round pillars with carved leaf capitals carrying pointed arches that cross one above another into the distance, high windows of clear leaded glass filling the upper half with daylight, one round window of blue and gold stained glass over the far arch, a gilded organ case with painted shutters hanging on the wall at the right, black diamond shaped memorial boards fixed to the pillars, two great brass chandeliers hung on long cords down the middle, a carved wooden pulpit standing against the near pillar with a small black gowned preacher leaning out of it with his hand put out as he speaks, a long brown panelled pew front running right across the middle of the picture with rows of men in wide black hats behind it, and in front of it a congregation seated on chairs, a woman in a black hood with a white collar, a small child in a yellow coat, two women with their backs turned in black cloaks and white caps, a man standing in a long black coat with a white collar, a brown and white dog sitting in the aisle, and swept flagstones below them crossed by a broad shaft of daylight, all i have is yours, and all you have is mine, and in them i have been glorified, …
pictures.name: pd_de_witte_interior_of_the_oude_kerk

pictures.scene: Anton Mauve, The Return of the Flock — a great flock of sheep coming over open heathland in the late afternoon, the animals packed close together and filling the whole lower two thirds of the picture, their rough fleeces painted in warm cream, tan and olive with the light lying along their backs, nearly all of them moving away from us with their heads down in the heather, one small white lamb standing alone in the middle of the picture turned right round and looking straight back at us, its thin legs apart in the dark grass, a low brown ridge of heath running across behind them with dry heather, bracken and one small green bush worked into it, one shepherd walking at the top of the flock in a dark coat and cap with his long crook held out behind him, two or three birds flying in the pale flat grey sky above the ridge, fine craquelure all over the paint, and worked rough grass, sand and dark scrub running right out to the bottom edge, holy father, protect them by your name, not one of them has been lost, …
pictures.name: pd_mauve_flock

pictures.scene: Jean Leon Gerome, The Christian Martyrs' Last Prayer — the floor of a Roman amphitheatre with one enormous lion standing out in the open sand, seen from the side with his heavy dark mane, his head turned away across the arena and his great paws planted in the raked sand, the tiered seats of the amphitheatre sweeping round behind him in a long curve and packed solid with thousands of tiny spectators painted as dabs of white and grey, rank above rank behind the barrier, a colonnade of small columns running along the top rim against the sky, a carved stone gate with green doors standing shut in the middle of the wall, two tall stakes burning at the left with ragged orange flame and black smoke blowing off them, a statue with a spear lifted on a high block of pale stone beyond the rim, heavy grey and cream storm cloud worked across the top of the picture, and the wide pale arena sand swept in long curved rake marks right across the whole bottom of the frame, i have given them your word and the world has hated them, …
pictures.name: pd_gerome_martyrs

pictures.scene: Jan Pynas, The Liberation of Saint Peter — a prison at night with nearly the whole upper part of the picture simply black, and out of that darkness two figures walking quietly toward a doorway at the left, an angel leading in a long stiff dalmatic of orange and gold worked all over with embroidery, white tasselled cords hanging at his breast, great dark wings rising behind his shoulders, his young face bent down and calm, one hand put out pointing to the way out and the other reaching back to take the old man by the wrist, behind him the apostle, bald and grey bearded, stooping forward in a great plain mantle of pale gold falling in heavy folds from his shoulder to his feet, one hand closed and lifted at his breast, both men walking barefoot in sandals over a floor of broad pale stone slabs that catches all the light, at the right a guard slumped fast asleep on the ground in a brilliant scarlet robe with his head fallen on his hand and his bare feet thrown out across the stones, his helmet and a sheepskin lying at the bottom left, and a few bright fragments of metal and a bowl on the floor at the lower right, i am not asking that you take them out of the world, but that you keep them from the evil one, …
pictures.name: pd_pynas_the_liberation_of_saint_peter

pictures.scene: Vincent van Gogh, Still Life with Bible — one enormous old family Bible lying open on a table and filling the whole middle of the picture, its heavy leather boards fallen away on both sides, the thick block of pages shown edge on in a wide band of cream and brown, and the two open leaves painted in long pale strokes of white, grey and ochre with the columns of print only suggested and never spelled out, the book's clasps hanging loose at the left, behind it a tall brass candlestick standing up against the dark with a thick white candle in it, the wick burnt black and the candle not lit, a turned wooden chair back showing dimly further back, the whole top of the picture simply black, a small worn yellow covered book with a broken spine lying on the cloth at the lower right, and below everything a coarse ochre and brown table cloth worked in heavy streaks of paint that runs right out to the bottom edge, sanctify them by the truth, your word is truth, …
pictures.name: pd_gogh_bijbel

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, Saint Peter Preaching — a fresco of one old apostle standing at the left and speaking to a crowd gathered close about him, his white hair and short white beard under a plain gold halo, a pale blue tunic falling from his shoulders and a great deep orange mantle gathered up over his arm and hanging to the ground in wide folds, one hand lifted open beside his face as he speaks and the other holding the cloth at his waist, his bare feet set on the step at the bottom of the picture, the crowd pressed in at the right and filling the lower half of the wall, two women kneeling in the front in a dark blue green mantle and a white wimple with their faces lifted to him, an old man bowed beside them in a rose red cloak with a long white beard, behind them a bank of twenty and more heads in blue and red caps, white hoods, bare heads and tonsures, all turned toward him, a tall man in a long white robe and a dark green mantle standing at the right edge, a wooded blue green mountain rising behind them over the whole upper part of the picture with small dark trees worked into its slopes, and a strip of bare plaster showing at the top and down the right side, also on behalf of those who will believe in me through their message, …
pictures.name: pd_fra_angelico_saint_peter_preaching

pictures.scene: Juan de Juanes, The Last Supper — the middle of a long supper table seen close up, Christ seated behind it in the very centre in a soft violet grey tunic with a great crimson mantle falling from His shoulder, His right hand lifted high holding up a round white wafer that catches all the light, His left hand laid flat on His breast, His long auburn hair falling on both shoulders and His face turned straight out at us, a tall round arch of grey stone opening directly behind His head onto a green hillside with a far house, dark cypresses and a pale blue evening sky, heavy stone columns rising on both sides of it, Peter seated at the left in a dark green coat over a rose red sleeve with grey curling hair and a short white beard, his hand laid on his own breast and his face turned up to Christ, his gold halo lettered PETRVS, John at the right in a green doublet with his face lifted and both hands opened before him, his gold halo lettered IOANNES, two more hands and a sleeve reaching in at the right edge, a long white damask cloth running right across the middle of the picture and carrying a wide silver dish, a gold footed chalice set in front of Christ, three small loaves, a gold salt cellar, two knives and a little dish of fruit, and below the cloth a chequered marble floor with the bare feet of the apostles showing under the table and a broad golden basin standing at the bottom, that all of them may be one, as you, father, are in me, and i am in you, …
pictures.name: pd_juanes_last_supper

pictures.scene: Andrea Mantegna, The Ascension — Christ carried up into an open blue sky strewn with small white clouds, standing upright on a little round platform of grey blue cloud with His bare feet showing beneath the hem, a long deep blue mantle wrapped about Him and falling in heavy carved folds to His ankles over an orange red tunic, one hand lifted in blessing with two fingers raised, the other holding a tall slender staff topped with a gold cross and a white banner crossed with red, His bearded face bowed a little and ringed with a thin gold halo, and all round Him a tall oval wreath of small red winged cherub heads looking out from banks of blue grey cloud, below Him the ground rising on both sides in great tawny rock walls with thin saplings growing out of the cracks, a brown crag in the middle hung with dark scrub, and at the bottom the whole company gathered on the hillside looking up, Mary standing in the middle in a white head cloth and a dark green mantle over a red gown with both hands opened wide, an old white bearded apostle at the left in a gold cloak holding a red book, others in rose, pale gold, grey blue and green cloaks crowded on both sides with their faces turned up and their mouths open, two of them kneeling in the front with their backs to us, that they may see the glory you gave me because you loved me before the foundation of the world, …
pictures.name: pd_mantegna_ascension

pictures.scene: Jacob de Wet, Christ Blessing the Children — a dim brown doorway of a great building with Christ seated in the middle of the picture on a low step, bending forward over the children gathered at His knees, a soft gold halo of light about His bowed head, His long hair falling forward, a pale cream robe loose at the throat with one hand laid on His own breast and a dull rose red mantle spread across His lap and down over the step, a young mother kneeling at the left in a white blouse, a blue bodice and a wide blue grey skirt with an orange sash, holding a small child in an orange shift on her arm and putting him forward, a little girl in grey standing beside her with her face lifted, a second small boy kneeling in the middle in a long cream smock and a striped cap with his hands joined in prayer, a fair haired child in a blue sleeved dress leaning on Christ's knee at the right and a smaller one in grey being lifted toward Him, a small boy in a red cap seen squarely from behind at the bottom of the picture sitting on the stones, a woman in a dark hood standing behind with a swaddled baby in her arms, a tall old man in a cream robe and a brown cloak standing high at the right looking down, more heads and shoulders pressed in at both edges, heavy brown piers and a dark doorway filling the upper part of the picture with fine craquelure all over the paint, and a worked pale stone step and bare earth with a few scattered timbers running across the bottom, so that the love you have for me may be in them, and i in them, …
pictures.name: pd_dewet_christus_zegent_kinderen

lines.text: When Jesus had spoken these things, He lifted up His eyes to heaven and said, Father, the hour has come. Glorify Your Son, that Your Son may glorify You.
For You granted Him authority over all people, so that He may give eternal life to all those You have given Him.
Now this is eternal life, that they may know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom You have sent.
I have glorified You on earth by accomplishing the work You gave Me to do.
And now, Father, glorify Me in Your presence with the glory I had with You before the world existed.
I have revealed Your name to those You have given Me out of the world. They were Yours; You gave them to Me, and they have kept Your word.
Now they know that everything You have given Me comes from You.
For I have given them the words You gave Me, and they have received them. They knew with certainty that I came from You, and they believed that You sent Me.
I ask on their behalf. I do not ask on behalf of the world, but on behalf of those You have given Me; for they are Yours.
All I have is Yours, and all You have is Mine; and in them I have been glorified.
I will no longer be in the world, but they are in the world, and I am coming to You. Holy Father, protect them by Your name, the name You gave Me, so that they may be one as We are one.
While I was with them, I protected and preserved them by Your name, the name You gave Me. Not one of them has been lost, except the son of destruction, so that the Scripture would be fulfilled.
But now I am coming to You; and I am saying these things while I am in the world, so that they may have My joy fulfilled within them.
I have given them Your word and the world has hated them; for they are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.
I am not asking that You take them out of the world, but that You keep them from the evil one.
They are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.
Sanctify them by the truth; Your word is truth.
As You sent Me into the world, I have also sent them into the world.
For them I sanctify Myself, so that they too may be sanctified by the truth.
I am not asking on behalf of them alone, but also on behalf of those who will believe in Me through their message,
that all of them may be one, as You, Father, are in Me, and I am in You. May they also be in Us, so that the world may believe that You sent Me.
I have given them the glory You gave Me, so that they may be one as We are one,
I in them and You in Me, that they may be perfectly united, so that the world may know that You sent Me and have loved them just as You have loved Me.
Father, I want those You have given Me to be with Me where I am, that they may see the glory You gave Me because You loved Me before the foundation of the world.
Righteous Father, although the world has not known You, I know You, and they know that You sent Me.
And I have made Your name known to them and will continue to make it known, so that the love You have for Me may be in them, and I in them.
